text:
ina: alerting eu-central1: GPU attach rate dropped, pods stuck Pending with ProvisionTimeout. any storage alerts?

sre-bot: ALERT: nvme-pool-eu-central1 read p99=410ms, SMART temp warnings on 12 nodes, iowait spike correlating with backup-scrub and fs-rekey jobs.

eli: looking at node gnode-88: backup-scrub started at 01:50 and fs-rekey kicked at 01:52 after KMS rotation. they overlapped and produced sustained read bursts. kernel shows thermal throttling on nvme controller.

ravi: that explains attach failures. when NVMe temp hits threshold controller slows down, iops collapse. we need quick mitigation: stop backup-scrub and throttle rekey IO.

maya: can we retarget attaches away from eu-central1 temporarily? also anyone have a safe cgroup cap for fs-rekey?

eli: quick mitigations I ran on one node:
- pkill -SIGTERM backup-scrub; delayed reschedule
- ionice -c2 -n7 --most /usr/local/bin/fs-rekey-worker &
- cgcreate -g blkio:rekey; echo 500 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/rekey/blkio.throttle.read_iops_device

ina: thanks. I'm pausing the backup cron and adding cage for rekey jobs in key-ops (ravi). routing: flip regional-preference to eu-west1 for 20m for new GPU attaches.

sre-bot: ACTION: backup-cron paused (maya). key-ops rekey queue rate-limited (ravi). regional routing adjusted: prefer eu-west1 for 20m. nodes signalled to cool down.

ravi: after stopping scrub + capping rekey, node p99 back to ~35ms on sample set. SMART temps trending down. attach retries succeeding.

eli: follow-ups: 1) add interlock in key-ops + backup scheduler to avoid concurrent heavy local IO; 2) add nvme temp monitor alert to preempt thermal throttle; 3) document rollback play (pause jobs + regional flip + per-node cgroup cap).

maya: cost ops note: regional flip will likely add ~8% short-term egress/latency cost for customers in EU; acceptable to avoid SLA hits.

ina: filing INFRA-8033: "avoid concurrent rekey+scrub causing nvme thermal throttle -> gpu attach failures" with playbook and estimated cost. assigning to storage and key-ops.

maya: nice work team, monitoring eu-central1 for 30m, will re-enable cron once nodes stable. :white_check_mark:
